use_titles: Chat titles, agent tab names and todo titles
use_reply_or_agent: Deciding whether to reply or hand to an agent
source_auto: Automatic (a connection the hub can call directly)
status_no_api: No model the hub can call directly: launchers like “Claude Code default” only start on a computer and can’t be used here. Add a connection with a key in Settings › Model providers, then pick it
err_launcher_not_responses: A launcher cannot be used as this API connection
err_not_callable: The hub can’t call this provider’s API directly
err_provider_type: Provider must be a string or null
err_field_type: Model fields must be strings or null
err_field_invalid: Model fields can’t be empty or contain line breaks
err_no_database: No database, so the model config can’t be saved
err_conflict: The config was changed. Reload, then save
err_provider_unsupported: This provider doesn’t support this use
err_extension_model: The extension doesn’t have this model
err_launcher_not_on_machine: The computer this use runs on doesn’t have this launcher
err_agent_launcher: Agents can only start with a Claude Code or Codex launcher
err_codex_effort: A new Codex’s reasoning effort is set by its launcher. Switch back to inherited
err_purpose_readonly: This use’s model is read-only. Change its category’s model instead
err_api_effort: This API connection doesn’t support reasoning effort
triage_in_use: These extensions use “Message triage” to sort the inbox: {names}. Turn them off in Settings › Extensions before changing this model
err_api_as_launcher: This use points to a direct API connection that cannot run as a launcher
err_runtime_invalid: Runtime must be cli or agentsdk
err_runtime_assistant_only: Only the main chat can choose a runtime
use_delegate: Deciding whether to answer an agent's question for you
source_auto_named: Automatic: {provider} (a connection the hub can call directly)
err_model_invalid: Model ID {model} can’t be used: it must start with a letter or digit (or ~ and then one) and have only letters, digits and . _ - / : @ [ ], up to 256 characters
custom_model_description: A model ID you used before
err_role_forget: Full access is required to forget a model ID.
